title: A study on Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs. Part 5: Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs of orders 48, 81, 96
summary: This study is the $5^{th}$ part of a detailed study on Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs having ten parts \cite{v2-1}-\cite{v2-10} and is a continuation of Part 4. Here, we study Type-2 isomorphic circulant graphs of $C_{48}(r_1,r_2,r_3)$, $C_{81}(r_1,r_2,r_3)$ and $C_{96}(r_1,r_2,r_3,r_4)$. We find that the total number of pairs of isomorphic circulant graphs of Type-2 w.r.t. $m$ = 2 of the forms $C_{n}(r_1,r_2,r_3)$ and $C_{n}(s_1,s_2,s_3)$ are 18 and 72 for $n$ = 48, 96, respectively and the total number of triples of isomorphic circulant graphs of Type-2 w.r.t. $m$ = 3 of the form…
